name: Breakfast on the Beach
shortDescription: Enjoy your breakfast on your private beach! In Thalasses Villas this can be arranged.
longDescription:
Enjoy your breakfast on your private beach! In Thalasses Villas this can be arranged.

Check out our latest Video here!
todos: META description, og:description and twitter:description are all just the page title ("Breakfast on the Beach"); there is no unique SEO description in the source.
Body copy is only two sentences. Nothing is stated about what is served, at which beach, at what times, for how many people, or how a guest arranges it.
No highlights, bullets or structured list exist in the source, so highlights is empty.
The only link on the page uses the bare anchor text "here" ("Check out our latest Video here!"), which is poor link text for accessibility and SEO; it points to a YouTube video.

No photo gallery on this page — the only page-specific image is the hero/parallax background. The page's .imgs.txt lists only site chrome besides it (logo, gradient, W3C validator badges, and a commented-out newsletter background).
No duration stated anywhere in the source page; duration left null.
No price, rate or 'from' figure stated anywhere in the source page; price left null.

No page-specific call to action exists in the source. The only CTA on the page is the site-wide booking bar ("Book now" -> https://thalassesvillas.reserve-online.net/), which is global chrome, so cta is null.
categoryProposed is an editorial grouping added for the redesign; the live site has no categories — confirm with the client.
